dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(['datetime'])
| extend ExecutionTypeCode = toint(['type'])
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Checkpoint = checkpoint,
    EventDateTime = tostring(['datetime']),
    ExecutionType = ExecutionTypeCode,
    ExecutionTypeName = case(ExecutionTypeCode == 0, 'Trusted Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 1, 'Blocked Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 2, 'Untrusted Execution [Audit]', ExecutionTypeCode == 3, 'Untrusted Execution [OTP]', ExecutionTypeCode == 4, 'Trusted Path Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 5, 'Trusted Publisher Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 6, 'Blocklist Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 7, 'Blocklist Execution [Audit]', ExecutionTypeCode == 8, 'Trusted Process Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 9, 'Constrained Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 10, 'Trusted Metadata Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 11, 'Trusted Browser Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 12, 'Blocked Browser Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 13, 'Untrusted Browser Execution [Audit]', ExecutionTypeCode == 14, 'Untrusted Browser Execution [OTP]', ExecutionTypeCode == 15, 'Blocklist Browser Execution [Audit]', ExecutionTypeCode == 16, 'Blocklist Browser Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 17, 'Trusted Installer Execution', ExecutionTypeCode == 18, 'Trusted Browser Metadata Execution', 'Unknown'),
    Username = username,
    Hostname = hostname,
    NetDomain = netdomain,
    FileName = filename,
    FilePath = path,
    ParentPolicy = ppolicy,
    PolicyName = policyname,
    PolicyVersion = policyver,
    PolicyId = policyid,
    CommandLine = commandline,
    Publisher = publisher,
    ParentProcess = pprocess,
    GrandparentProcess = gprocess,
    SHA256 = sha256,
    MD5 = md5,
    SHA128 = sha128,
    SHA384 = sha384,
    SHA512 = sha512,
    IPAddress = ip,
    LocalIPAddress = localip,
    ExtensionId = extid,
    ExtensionName = extname,
    ExtensionType = exttype,
    ExtensionBrowser = extbrowser,
    MetaruleId = metaruleid,
    PackageId = packageid,
    ConnectorName = ['friendlyName']

source
| extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(['datetime'])
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Checkpoint = checkpoint,
    EventDateTime = tostring(['datetime']),
    Task = task,
    User = ['user'],
    Description = description,
    ConnectorName = ['friendlyName']
